note: v462: Reconciliation now keeps your accounts separate automatically. A record that already reconciled on one account (e.g. a business expense matched on your Business account) no longer shows up as unmatched 'in your books' when you reconcile your Personal account — it's recognized as clearing through the other account. Tap 'Check all 12 months' on each account once so it learns where everything belongs. In Find any record, such records show as 'On <account>' with a tap to jump there. No manual tagging needed.
